visual: White flowers with vivid pink picotee edges · dark-pink buds · purple-flecked foliage
prune: Remove spent flowering stalks; cut back in early spring
cvs: trade name Rosy Jane; cultivar code 'Harrosy'
hardinessNote: RHS H4; hardy through most of the UK
resilience: drought tolerant once established · wind tolerant · urban suitable
uses: borders · containers · prairie planting · wildlife gardens
uncertain: The label identifies the plant as Gaura 'Rosy Jane'; RHS now places the cultivar under Oenothera lindheimeri 'Harrosy' and lists 'Rosy Jane' and 'Rosyjane' as synonyms
RHS gives 0.5–1 m height and 0.1–0.5 m spread; exact-cultivar nursery sources commonly give about 60–90 cm tall and 40–60 cm wide, so the practical spread was narrowed
RHS records the cultivar as trade name status and the breeder denomination 'Harrosy' as PBR
